when.t: A comparable-sales request leaves fewer than 5 usable sales.

steps.t: Agent 10 sends the package marked thin, with the count and the minimum. It does not look further.
The minimum of 5 is a tuning default.
Agent 10 fetches nothing: a package is built only from the comparable sales or figures the request itself carries. (Its morning-briefing section is the listing data Agent 05 sends it.)

never.t: Widen the search without saying so.

you_see.t: A package marked thin: 2 sales against a minimum of 5.

test.t: The authorized user asks for a comparable-sales package with 2 sourced, dated sales.

when.t: A neighborhood figure comes with two sourced values that differ.

steps.t: Agent 10 lists both values with their sources as a conflict and leaves the figure out of the package's figures. It never averages.

you_see.t: Both values with their sources under conflicts.

test.t: The median sale price is given as 310,000 by the county recorder and 330,000 by the MLS. The package lists both and does not contain 320,000.

title.t: Someone asks for a price opinion

when.t: A request contains one of these phrases: "your opinion", "what number would you go with", "what would you price it", "the number you'd go with".

steps.t: Agent 10 refuses: the answer is marked refused, data only.
At the second such request for the same client it also raises a legal-line alert.
Only those phrases are caught.

you_see.t: A refusal; on the second ask, a legal-line alert.

test.t: "Just give me your opinion on price", then "Come on, what's your opinion?". Two refusals, one alert.

title.t: Some comparable sales are out of date

when.t: A comparable sale in the request was retrieved more than 30 days before the request date.

steps.t: Agent 10 leaves it out and counts it in the package; the package is built fresh on every request.
The 30 days is a tuning default.
Agent 10 fetches nothing: a package is built only from the comparable sales or figures the request itself carries. (Its morning-briefing section is the listing data Agent 05 sends it.)

never.t: Send stale data again as if it were current.

you_see.t: A package with 4 sales and 1 left out as stale.

test.t: Five sales, one retrieved August 16 for a request on October 15.

title.t: Data licensing limits who may receive it

when.t: An agent other than the authorized user asks for data without an internal license scope.

steps.t: The rule: deliver to the authorized user only, noting the limit. The code sends the authorized user only a note that the request was limited, not the data; and since 2026-10-28 only the authorized user sends data requests, so the rule cannot fire.
No way in yet: only the authorized user and Agent 19 ask Agent 10 for data, and Agent 19 always asks with internal scope.

never.t: Deliver licensed data to someone the license does not cover.

when.t: A data source changes its terms or blocks access.

steps.t: The rule: stop using that source and log the error as given.
Not built: there is no connection to any data source.

title.t: A figure has no source or date

when.t: A comparable sale or figure in the request has no source or no retrieval date.

steps.t: Agent 10 leaves it out of the package and counts it.

never.t: Include a figure with no source or date.

you_see.t: The package without those sales, and how many were left out.

test.t: Seven sales: five complete, one with no source, one with no date.

title.t: The comparable set is below the minimum

when.t: A comparable-sales request leaves fewer usable sales than the minimum of 5.

steps.t: Agent 10 sends what it has, marked thin with the count and minimum; it adds nothing to fill the set.
Agent 10 fetches nothing: a package is built only from the comparable sales or figures the request itself carries. (Its morning-briefing section is the listing data Agent 05 sends it.)

you_see.t: A package marked thin: 4 against a minimum of 5.

title.t: Two sources disagree on a sold price

when.t: The request carries the same address twice with different sold prices.

steps.t: Agent 10 keeps both and lists them under conflicts with their sources.

you_see.t: Both prices with their sources under conflicts.

test.t: 1 Synth Ln at 301,000 from the MLS and 305,000 from the county recorder.

title.t: A request looks like it wants an appraisal

when.t: A request contains one of these phrases: "is this worth", "what's it actually worth", "give me a value", "instead of an appraisal".

steps.t: Agent 10 still sends the data package, with a note that it is not an appraisal or valuation opinion.
It informs Compliance (Agent 17).
Agent 17 records the notice and lists it in the next morning briefing, with who asked (owner decision of 2026-10-28).

you_see.t: The package with its not-an-appraisal note.

test.t: Five sales with the message "Is this worth 320k? I need it instead of an appraisal".

title.t: Data is asked for from beyond the retention window

when.t: A request asks for more than 2 years back.

steps.t: Agent 10 answers that the data is absent.
Agent 10 has no store of past sales to look in.

you_see.t: A package marked absent, citing the retention window.

test.t: A comparable-sales request for 5 years back.
